lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Co4O8 (reduced formula LiCo2O4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors (Co–O distances 1.87–1.98 Å), while Li centers have eight O neighbors. O atoms coordinate to two Co neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Co octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra and Li 8-vertex polyhedra.
